    • createStmtToOwnerMap

      protected Map<Stmt,Body> createStmtToOwnerMap()
      Data flow solvers query the ICFG concurrently, while statements may be registered with setOwnerStatement(Stmt, Body). Statements are compared by identity, so a concurrent hash map keeps the identity semantics.

    • getStartPoints

      protected Collection<Stmt> getStartPoints(Body body)
      Returns the heads of the graph exposed by this ICFG. Without exceptional edges, trap handlers have no predecessor and are therefore heads as well (like Soot's BriefUnitGraph). With exceptional edges, trap handlers are reached from the statements they protect and only the statements without any predecessor remain heads (like Soot's ExceptionalUnitGraph).
